description:
NSWCPD has a requirement for TCB Unit 2 Assembly Components.  The drawings associated with this requirement have a distribution D CUI statement attached to them.  To view the RFQ and drawings, a JCP Certification must be submitted.  Please send your company's JCP Certification to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil.  This requirement is currently being pre-solicited as a total small business set aside.  This pre-solicitation notice closes on 04/21/2026 at COB.  The RFQ and drawing swill be issued after the closing of the pre-solicitation notice.

Please email all questions to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
